bias_targets.methodology: Comparing the agreement of default LLM responses with those of LLMs prompted to act with specific political personas (e.g., Democrat, Republican) across political questionnaires.
Prompting LLMs with medical questions known to elicit race-based misconceptions and measuring the frequency of problematic, highly racialized, or debunked medical responses.

Using the BiasPainter framework to provide seed images and neutral text prompts to image generation and editing models, then automatically detecting inappropriate or biased changes along gender, race, and age dimensions.

Utilizing the GlobalOpinionQA dataset to prompt LLMs on subjective issues and measuring the similarity of their responses against human survey data from different countries to detect Western-oriented perspective dominance.

Evaluating tokenization disparity by measuring the number of tokens required to process the exact same sentence across different languages, which translates to unequal inference costs and processing times for non-English speakers.
